(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said columnar body has a cross-section that is one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are arranged in a non-overlapping configuration radially around the columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, and wherein said base member is configured to provide a means for electrical connection.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are arranged in a configuration that allows for improved thermal management and light distribution.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, wherein said optic element is configured to enhance light distribution.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The lamp of claim 1 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, and wherein said circuitry is configured to optimize power efficiency.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light in a manner that enhances illumination efficiency. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
